# Decider

> > Your guide to what's worth watching in streaming, TV, and movies with entertainment news, reviews, and recommendations.

Decider covers streaming entertainment, television shows, movies, and celebrity news with daily headlines, episode recaps, and pop culture commentary. The site features content about major streaming platforms like Amazon and popular franchises including The Walking Dead, SpongeBob SquarePants, Pirates of the Caribbean, and Shrek.

## Key Topics

- streaming entertainment
- TV shows and series
- The Walking Dead
- celebrity news
- movie coverage
- SpongeBob SquarePants
- streaming platforms (Amazon, etc.)
- entertainment controversies
- pop culture mashups
- daily entertainment headlines
- Pirates of the Caribbean
- Shrek franchise
- streaming events
- image galleries
